paragraphs: Zekharyah ben Kevutal the priest, in Yoma chapter 1, Mishnah 18b:“Many times I read before the high priest on the Day of Atonement from Daniel.” Rav indicates the reading Kevutal, with bet rather than pe, there 19b. He lived near the destruction. His grandson was a great sage, sent with Rabbi Yose ben Kipper to Chananya, son of Rabbi Yehoshua’s brother, who intercalated years outside the Land:end of Berakhot 63a. In chapter Yotze Dofen he reported Rabbi Elazar. Maimonides omitted his mention among the priests. See Yuchasin, in the order of the generations, under Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok, concerning the priests.
